response.answer: ColBERT pads a query with fewer than a predefined number Nq tokens using BERT’s special [mask] tokens up to length Nq; otherwise it truncates the query to the first Nq tokens [1]. This padding with masked tokens is called query augmentation and allows BERT to produce query-based embeddings at the positions corresponding to these masks [1]. The same augmentation is not applied to documents: unlike queries, ColBERT does not append [mask] tokens to documents [2].
